# Fred Victor

> > Fred Victor is a leading Toronto nonprofit organization dedicated to ending homelessness through emergency shelters, affordable housing, mental health services, food security programs, and community support.

Operating across Toronto neighborhoods including Regent Park and Moss Park, Fred Victor provides comprehensive services ranging from emergency respite and transitional housing to harm reduction, case management, and community-building initiatives like Taste of Regent Park and Fred's Walk fundraiser.

## Key Topics

- homelessness
- affordable housing
- poverty
- emergency shelter services
- transitional housing

## Core Services & Programs

- [Fred Victor - Leader In Ending Homelessness in Toronto](https://www.fredvictor.org): Homepage for Toronto homeless shelter and affordable housing services
- [Emergency Respite Centre - Services for the Homeless](https://www.fredvictor.org/what-we-do/housing/emergency-respite-centre): 24/7 emergency shelter at Better Living Centre with cots, meals, showers
- [Transitional Housing - Housing Supports For Complex Needs](https://www.fredvictor.org/what-we-do/housing/transitional-housing): Intensive support housing for chronic homelessness at 145 Queen Street
- [Mental Health Services - Support & Outreach](https://www.fredvictor.org/what-we-do/health-services/mental-health): Mental health support, outreach, and case management services
- [Food Security Programs - in Toronto](https://www.fredvictor.org/food-security-programs): Food access, skills, gardens, and advocacy in Moss Park & Regent Park
- [Taste of Regent Park](https://www.fredvictor.org/taste-of-regent-park): Weekly summer market with subsidized food and vendors at Regent Park

## Get Involved & Support

- [Donate to Fred Victor - Help People Who Are Homeless in Toronto!](https://www.fredvictor.org/secure-donation-form): Secure online donation form for one-time or monthly contributions
- [Fred's Walk - Walk, Fundraise, Make a Difference](https://www.fredvictor.org/help-homeless-support-us/freds-walk): Annual charity walk fundraiser through Toronto to support homelessness
- [Volunteer Opportunities For Your Team in Toronto](https://www.fredvictor.org/help-homeless-support-us/corporate-volunteer): Corporate team building volunteer programs supporting homeless services
- [Food Donations - What and where to donate](https://www.fredvictor.org/food-donations): Guidelines and drop-off locations for food donations in Toronto
- [Locations and Contact Information - Emergency Info](https://www.fredvictor.org/location-information): Contact info and locations for shelters, housing, health, and donations

## Blog & Resources on Homelessness

- [Best Blog About Homelessness and Poverty in Toronto](https://www.fredvictor.org/best-blog-about-homelessness-and-poverty): Blog hub covering homelessness, poverty, and housing crisis in Toronto
- [How Long Could You Survive Living on the Streets?](https://www.fredvictor.org/2019/11/22/how-long-could-you-survive-on-the-streets): Blog post on hardships and dangers of street homelessness in Canada
- [Top Four Reasons People Become Homeless in Toronto](https://www.fredvictor.org/2020/02/25/why-dont-the-homeless-just-go-home): Blog explaining housing loss, affordability crisis, and homelessness causes
- [Negative Perceptions Hurt: Attitudes Toward The Homeless](https://www.fredvictor.org/2020/03/05/negative-perceptions-hurt-attitudes-toward-the-homeless): Blog addressing stigma and prejudice against homeless people in Toronto
